summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on deploying a new firmware (v53-dirty) into the RMS system, which includes channel switching and additional fields. Two testing strategies were proposed:

1. **Office Testing:** Using two adjacent devices in the office—one with the new firmware and one with the previous version.
2. **Field Testing:** Flashing a new firmware onto an existing device located in a city store for testing.

The team confirmed that two units at local sites were successfully flashed.
decisions: Two adjacent devices will be used for comparative testing (new vs. old firmware) in the office.
A field testing option was identified using existing store locations.
